profile_text.body:
Baidu is a Chinese public company (NASDAQ: BIDU, CIK 0001329099) whose AI-facing web presence centers on its ERNIE family of foundation models, hosted at ernie.baidu.com. The company describes its flagship as ERNIE 5.0, a 2.4 trillion-parameter unified multimodal model trained from scratch that integrates text, image, video, and audio into a single autoregressive framework, which Baidu says overcomes the limitations of late-fusion architectures for cross-modal understanding and generation. Alongside it, the company has published ERNIE-Image, a text-to-image generation model built on a single-stream Diffusion Transformer with 8 billion DiT parameters, and PaddleOCR-VL-1.5, an OCR-focused model the company says achieves 94.5% accuracy on OmniDocBench v1.5, described as a state-of-the-art result on that benchmark.

The site's held facts categorize ERNIE as a Chinese foundation model and flag that cross-border data review is advised for users outside China, a practical consideration given the regulatory environment around Chinese AI systems. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or patent filings appear in the available data.
